liveProvider.note: This checkpoint changes deterministic finalization, grading, evidence, and compiler-output policy; it makes no new live-provider claim.

manualHuman.note: No instructor, learner, classroom, factual-certification, accessibility-certification, or efficacy claim is made.

claims.summary: An unavailable finalize-time grade owns one quality blocker, sets package status blocked, disables download, and cannot produce the ready-to-download message.

Timeout and grader-error attempts retain a recoverable blob while adding an explicit ungraded quality report and manifest readiness blocker; attempted non-graded ZIPs are not physically saved, and same-click finishes cannot reuse stale proof.
The whole finalize pass has a 15-second assembly margin beyond the inner grader budget, and a boundary regression proves a terminal inner result is retained.

Deep grader V1.11.6 applies visible-unit policy V2 to lesson plans, assignments, and rubrics with ordinary-course floors and a strongest-family penalty cap; the expanded guard also drove Trellis's golden package from repeated directions at 89/B to varied output at 98/A.

claims.summary: AppFlow and compiler gzip content ceilings are restored while a separately named 64-byte tolerance accounts for observed Node/zlib variance.

The named checkpoint is limited to reproducible deterministic compiler, grader, export, and evidence behavior and explicitly excludes factual, accessibility, pedagogical, instructor, and classroom certification.
